description.value:
You are a master at forming well-defended emplacements with your Eldritch Cannon.

Double Firepower. You can now have two cannons at the same time, and you can create two with the same Magic action (if you expend a spell slot to create the first, you must expend another for the second). You can activate both with the same Bonus Action, ordering them to use the same option or different ones. You can't create a third cannon while you have two.

Shimmering Field Projection. You and your allies have Half Cover while within 10 feet of your Eldritch Cannon.
